programs.name: Abstract in a Day
programs.description: Spend a day experimenting,  playing and creating in this hands-on abstract painting intensive. Designed  for busy creatives, explore palette knives, brushes, taping, pouring, collage and other techniques while drawing inspiration from historical and contemporary  abstraction. Create a series of experimental pieces throughout the day before  bringing your favourite techniques together in one bold, completely unique  final artwork. No experience necessary—just  come ready to experiment and make something your own!

programs.name: Painting
programs.description: Explore your creativity through acrylic paint and watercolours. Learn about and practice skills including shading, brush strokes, use of colour and texture.

programs.name: Painting: Acrylic
programs.description: Create pictures with acrylic paint. Learn how to mix and choose colours, how to use tools to create different textures and add layers of paint to create depth.

programs.name: Sculpture
programs.description: Create in 3D! Using a variety of materials like clay, plasticine, paper mache and other recycled materials you will learn to mold, form, carve and caste to create beautiful art.

programs.name: Tennis: Recreational
programs.description: Develop skills though play with recreational tennis. Players of all levels can register to join the fun and participate in structured scrimmages where staff will ensure rules are followed and participation is balanced. There is no formal instruction.

programs.name: Adult Swim 2
programs.description: Build confidence in deep water one stroke at a time. Develop front crawl, back crawl, glides and staying afloat in deep water. Learn stride entry, eggbeater kick and breaststroke. Work towards a continuous swim of 50 to 100 meters. Prerequisite: Successful completion of or skill ability equal to Adult Swim 1.

programs.name: Badminton
programs.description: Instructional sports activities are designed to introduce sport-specific skills while improving fundamental movement with agility, balance and coordination. In racket sports you will play badminton. That focuses on hand-eye coordination and has you using your racquet to rally for points with a ‘birdie or ball" you will learn basics like grip, serve and swing, as well as game rules through drills, practice and play.

programs.name: Ball Hockey: Instructional
programs.description: Instructional sports programs are designed to introduce sport-specific skills while improving fundamental movement with agility, balance and coordination. In this non-ice version of hockey played with a ball, you will learn basics like passing, shooting and stick handling as well as game rules through drills, practice and play. Equipment: Players must bring a CSA-approved helmet and hockey gloves.

programs.name: Basketball: Instructional

programs.name: Bronze Star
programs.description: This course develops swimming proficiency, lifesaving skill and personal fitness. Candidates refine their stroke mechanics, acquire self-rescue skills, and apply fitness principles in training workouts. Bronze Star is excellent preparation for success in Bronze Medallion and provides a fun introduction to lifesaving sport.Prerequisite: Minimum age of 9 years old.

programs.description: Develop skills though play with recreational tennis. Players of all levels can register to join the fun and participate in structured scrimmages where staff will ensure rules are followed and participation is balanced. There is no formal instruction.

programs.name: Adult Swim 2
programs.description: Build confidence in deep water one stroke at a time. Develop front crawl, back crawl, glides and staying afloat in deep water. Learn stride entry, eggbeater kick and breaststroke. Work towards a continuous swim of 50 to 100 meters. Prerequisite: Successful completion of or skill ability equal to Adult Swim 1.

Equipment: Players must bring a CSA-approved helmet and hockey gloves.

programs.name: Pilates
programs.description: Build core strength and improve flexibility with this head-to-toe workout. As you progress through slow-paced movements, performed in sequence, you will learn to incorporate an awareness of the spine and breath in this complete approach to well being.

programs.name: Pottery

programs.name: Abstract in a Day
programs.description: Spend a day experimenting,  playing and creating in this hands-on abstract painting intensive. Designed  for busy creatives, explore palette knives, brushes, taping, pouring, collage and other techniques while drawing inspiration from historical and contemporary  abstraction. Create a series of experimental pieces throughout the day before  bringing your favourite techniques together in one bold, completely unique  final artwork. No experience necessary—just  come ready to experiment and make something your own!

programs.name: Acrylic Landscapes

Learn how to transform a blank canvas into a vibrant natural scene using colour, texture, layering, and composition techniques. Materials list will be provided.    This course is also offered as a four-week intensive.

programs.name: Abstract in a Day
programs.description: Spend a day experimenting,  playing and creating in this hands-on abstract painting intensive. Designed  for busy creatives, explore palette knives, brushes, taping, pouring, collage and other techniques while drawing inspiration from historical and contemporary  abstraction. Create a series of experimental pieces throughout the day before  bringing your favourite techniques together in one bold, completely unique  final artwork. No experience necessary—just  come ready to experiment and make something your own!

programs.name: Acrylic Landscapes

Learn how to transform a blank canvas into a vibrant natural scene using colour, texture, layering, and composition techniques. Materials list will be provided.    This course is also offered as a four-week intensive.
